definitions.explanation: Describes something that is exactly the right amount, size, timing, or degree — neither too much nor too little.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ちょうどいい。
ちょうどいい⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A phone call came at just the right time.

examples.japanese: {味|あじ}つけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ちょうどいい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{足|た}さなくて→足す：01168_tasu⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The seasoning is just right, so you don't need to add anything.

notes:
A very common colloquial expression combining ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧ (exactly) with ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good). Used constantly in everyday conversation to describe things that fit perfectly — temperature, timing, amount, size, distance, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ちょうどいい⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: just the right size
- ちょうどいい⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: just the right amount
- ちょうどいい⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧: perfect timing
- ちょうどいい⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: just the right distance
- ちょうどいい⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: just the right temperature

USAGE:
Can be used as a predicate (ちょうどいい) or as a modifier before nouns (ちょうどいい + noun). Unlike many い-adjectives, this is a fixed phrase and does not conjugate as a single unit — the ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ part conjugates normally: ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧ (was just right), ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧ (not quite right).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧: fits perfectly (emphasizes exact fit, often physical)
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧: appropriate (more formal, used in writing)
